item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded: Having read the article and the comment thread, I'm left feeling like this is one of the last bastions of what I've seen people refer to as the old foundation, around 2009 based on what I've seen. Not that there aren't many articles left from then, more in its style. If the author hadn't said himself that this wasn't him, I'd have pegged this as a self insert and kept moving. It has all the hallmarks, humanoid, uberpowerful, tortured and misunderstood, and a cornucopia of abilities. Deviantart OC symptoms aside, I also agree that there's probably something worth saving here. It's not a total Mary Sue, and I agree with others that the mental illness could be compelling. I'm downvoting, but with the hopes that something of this article survives a rewrite or deletion.

item.content:encoded: All right. I did like the idea, but this, I think, does need a revamp. The redaction is poor in places, and the containment procedures seem more like, "Well…this might keep the object contained. Possibly. Okay, we're really just throwing a shot in the dark here. I think. Hmm…maybe more acid?" At least that's the way I felt when I read them. And I agree with the posts above: it reads like an OTT humanoid. It can fairly easily breach containment and when it does its psychotic and goes on a murderous rampage. Needs an upgrade, but the idea is workable. Downvote for now on the hope of a rewrite.

item.title: Staff Post
item.content:encoded:
This article is up for review. Please read it, it needs more attention.

Okay, first of all, these containment procedures are just all over the place. It's got sleeping gas, acid, water, removing all the air from the chamber, electric current, hardened foam… I could go on. It really doesn't need all this, I think.

The article itself is really kind of dull. It's a metamorphic humanoid with a badly presented mental illness. The forms that it took in the past don't really interest me, they feel really over-the-top and silly. Also, the last addenda is pretty pointless with some bad expungement. If one were to try and improve this, I'd try to make more of a connection between the mental instability and the shapeshifting, preferably while also making the mental illness less tacked on.

I quite dislike this one. The imagery was all over the place. The metamorphic events are vague. Formatting is ok and addenda is meh. Overall I'd like to see this redone. -1

Edit: This is just too all over the place for my liking. It's constantly evolving, but not really, just changing from one terrible form to another without any real rhyme or reason it seems. It's super powerful, able to breach the cell and negate containment procedures on a 3 month cycle. The being's form shifts so radically that tombones comparison of this to Ben 10 feels about right. Without any narrative or other hook, this just feels too over the top, ever transforming nightmare monster to me. :/

I also don't get he energy storing thing at all. When was it taking in sunlight and what is all this energy for? More freak mutations every 3 months for breach attempts? How did we fin this thing and decide it used to be █████████ █████?
